remarks:
A remarkable blend of history, architecture, and modern living, this distinctive 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home was thoughtfully transformed from a former church into a comfortable and inviting residence. Offering approximately 2,300 square feet of living space, plus an additional 300-square-foot loft not included in the square footage, the flexible layout easily accommodates a home office, media room, play space, or additional gathering area.

The open-concept great room brings together the living, dining, and kitchen areas, creating a comfortable setting for everyday living and entertaining. Original architectural elements, including decorative church-style windows, provide character and abundant natural light throughout the home. The custom kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a large center island, and solid surface countertops. Four bedrooms, 2.5 baths, generous closet space, and the laundry and mechanical area were thoughtfully incorporated into what were once the building's classroom spaces.

Originally constructed in 1858 and serving the community for 165 years, the building has been extensively rebuilt with reinforced floor joists, new flooring, heating, electrical, well, siding, insulation, and 10 new windows. A new sewer connection is also planned, providing the benefits of modern infrastructure while preserving the building's historic character.

The property also offers generous parking and attractive outdoor sitting areas. Located just two miles from Chautauqua Institution, near Chautauqua Lake and popular snowmobile trail systems, the home provides convenient access to boating, fishing, winter recreation, and the arts and cultural experiences that make the area so special. Rich in character and thoughtfully updated throughout, this is a truly uncommon opportunity for those seeking a home with a story to tell.
